verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 4 remains sound and complete. The shared generated_at grammar is enforced both at artifact validation and at the service-order boundary; the new queue helper exact-matches repository rows before applying a deterministic, total, non-destructive rotation; and dispatch is bound to that helper with the validated plan and current repository. The change does not overclaim bounded fairness: it accurately characterizes hashing as probabilistic, retains the nonzero residual tail, and explains the scope tradeoff. The tests independently pin exact offsets, rotation shape, totality, per-repository isolation and delivery, malformed-input refusal including empty queues, production call-site arguments, and non-vacuity against representative permissive mutations. I found no correctness, soundness, test-validity, injection, or security issue in the diff. Because round 3 also had no findings at the same severity profile, progress is stagnant under the required rubric, while the verdict remains approve.
